page.layout: One column of running text under the running head; catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.l: nes venam secat in cubiti flexura, si nihil
cucurbitas praecordijs affigit: quibus si nò
castorij per uim ori infundit, & cyrenai-
cum succum,cum melle & aceto: & per se-
dem infundit centaurij decoctum, aut co-
ille tradit. Vetere autem affectos diu simi-
liter in aquæ potu continet, & in curatio-
nis aggressione venam secat, si nihil prohi-
lavat.Tertio die post praecordijs, ac dorso
stea capiti ac occipiti cucurbitas affigit.

page.notes: Long s rendered as "f" in "Poft"/"fufficientem" transcribed as plain s. "Postea" and "post" in the scan are written with long s and read accordingly. "Veruntamē", "nò", "Manè", "ò" kept as printed. Line-end broken words without a printed hyphen written whole ("præbet"). Running head and catchword as printed; "CAVSAS" read as CAUSAS per the u/v rule.
